method: Serial fresh processes/directories; seven paired native trials, three fresh microbenchmark processes per library with identical correctness-checked iteration/range/read harness; one final feature verification per workload; rotating paired order; identical current harness linked against both library revisions; no concurrent local builds/tests. Background workstation activity remains uncontrolled. Default native cache; Pebble/SQLite cache 512 MiB (SQLite per connection), Pebble memtable 64 MiB.
